profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I’m an experienced software engineer who loves solving problems to make users’ lives easier. The vast majority of my work has been back-end or server-side, but I’ve done some of everything from embedded software and device drivers to a tiny bit of web UI.

positions.title: SDE2
positions.description:
As a developer on the Microsoft Azure Compute Manager team I designed, implemented, tested, released, and supported live-site features to improve our IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service) offerings.

Stop Deallocate – When the user stops their IaaS VM, release their use of compute resources so they are no longer billed. They can also change configuration and those changes will take effect when the VM is restarted.

Delete Role Instances – Designed and implemented a REST API to delete a set of named PaaS role instances. This allows users to scale down their PaaS deployments by releasing specific resources.

VM Images – From a running (or stopped) VM, capture disk state and save a VM Image that can be used to create more instances of the VM. Designed and implemented with a co-developer.

Marketplace VM Images – Create VMs that are pre-loaded with tools and configuration from VM Images. Part of a three-person team to expand the design and implementation of platform images to include VM Images for both end users and industry partners. https://azuremarketplace.microsoft.com/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead for Groov, a browser-based screen editing tool for controlling Opto’s devices. Initiated the project, established the architecture, designed and implemented. Led junior developers to implement features that stretched their abilities while rounding out necessary functionality.

Created a testing framework for a redundant hot-swap control system. While one device runs the users’ control flow it sends updates to a backup that is ready to take over upon failure. The test system orchestrates 10 failure scenarios for 200 commands, yielding 2000 test cases.

Designed and implemented OptoDataLink, a C# application that links control systems to databases for logging from the device or updating values in the device.

Implemented Windows device drivers for PCI cards and an API to program them.

Enhanced and maintained the device communication and data gathering layers of a data aggregation server (OptoOPC Server). Included a 100x performance improvement for the most common usage pattern.

Created a new install system for software releases, shortening a two week process to an hour.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
On the Network Analyst team I designed and implemented support structures for solving graph optimization algorithms such as shortest path or traveling salesman, in C++ with COM.

Designed and implemented the algorithm that parsed geographic data and created a persistent connectivity index to enable fast graph traversal. File-based sort scaled the solution to the largest available dataset. Partial-incremental rebuild quickly updated the connectivity after future edits to the geographic data.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Added features to the in-house embedded operating system. Implemented the -r flag for rm, and formatted ls * output.

Created a Windows MFC app to interface with the Gordian-designed, IQinVision digital camera.
